title: Race Day - free 3D browser racer, one AI-built generated track every day
author: ranzy9
selftext:
Hey r/aigamedev,

I built Race Day, a free 3D racing game in the browser. A lot of it was built with AI help (code + iteration), then I shipped the daily multiplayer loop myself.

What it is:
- One shared track per day for everyone
- Track is freshly generated each day (different from past days)
- Finish a lap and your time goes to an open live leaderboard
- Competitive physics, medals, friends/world rankings, optional teams
- No account needed to race

Play: https://raceday.gg
itch: https://imranzdev.itch.io/raceday-gg

Happy to answer questions about the AI workflow, the daily challenge loop, or what broke in production.

comments.author: ranzy9
comments.body: Controls: WASD/arrows, Space checkpoint, R restart, Esc menu, M sound, V camera, F fullscreen.
